profile_text.body:
Cartesia is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes real-time text-to-speech through Sonic-3.6, a streaming TTS API that generates voices with laughter in 44 languages, positioned for AI agents and interactive apps. The company describes its broader aim as AI that learns and interacts like humans.

On its own account, the team has pioneered AI architectures including state space models (SSMs), Mamba and H-Nets, and the company frames its research as the realization of that mission. The facts held about Cartesia list no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its legal exposure entry is for California, with a count of 236.
